knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 5.1.9
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Which statement correctly names assumption differences between fully Bayesian credibility and Empirical Bayes and explains why premiums may differ?
knowledge_checks.body: Select Bayes versus EB contrast statement.
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Key contrast is specified structural knowledge versus estimated from collective data. Same method or software-only differences misstate the approaches.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Bayes: specified prior structure; EB: estimated structurals. Premiums can differ.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Treating Bayes and EB as identical or reversing who specifies structure.

choices.label: Fully Bayesian credibility treats structural or prior parameters as specified within a prior model. Empirical Bayes estimates those structural parameters from observed collective data. Different assumptions about structural knowledge can yield different premiums.
Bayesian and Empirical Bayes are the same method with different names; premiums must always agree.
Premiums differ only because software packages differ; assumptions about structural parameters are identical.
Empirical Bayes always uses a specified prior; fully Bayesian credibility never uses prior structure.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 5.1.9
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Which statement correctly states one key assumption difference between a fully Bayesian credibility approach and Empirical Bayes?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Specified versus estimated structural parameters is the core difference. Same-method and all-formulas-finished claims are misconceptions.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Specified prior structure vs estimated structurals from collective data.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Accepting same-method claim or reversed assumption roles.

choices.label: Bayesian treats structural or prior parameters as specified within a prior model; Empirical Bayes estimates those structural parameters from the observed collective data. They differ in how structural knowledge enters; contrasting them does not replace separate posterior, interval, and premium calculations.
Bayesian and Empirical Bayes are the same method with different names.
Contrasting them means every prior calculation, posterior, loss estimator, and premium formula is already finished.
Empirical Bayes specifies all structural parameters in advance; Bayesian credibility estimates them only from collective data.
